Home / Our Expertise

BIM expertise across every discipline.

Architecture, structure, MEP, infrastructure and BIM management: the disciplines, LODs, software and sectors ENGISOFT works in.

What we know

Two ways to use the same expertise.

ENGISOFT is a multidisciplinary BIM company in Dubai Silicon Oasis. The same engineering knowledge is used in two ways: placed inside your team as BIM professionals, or delivered by us as BIM packages.

Models are produced from LOD 100 to LOD 500, in native Revit and open IFC formats, to the standards in your BIM Execution Plan.
